steps.title: Ten small steps
steps.body:
**minor 7th** means an interval of ten half steps. C up to Bb is a minor 7th; Bb is two half steps below the next C.

**Why it matters:** A minor seventh above a root is a common extra sound in a chord.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: C3 is string 5 fret 3; Bb3 is string 3 fret 3. Compare Bb3 with B3, one half step higher.

items.prompt: Play C3, then go up a minor 7th.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Compare C–Bb with C–B. Major and minor here name the distance, not the whole chord.
